tags.name: Peak to Creek - Upper
tags.description: Upper Peak to Creek is the first half of the long, steep Blue Peak to Creek run that drops from the top of Peak Express Chairlift all the way down to Creekside base.  It starts at the top of Peak Express Chairlift and ends just into the treeline.

tags.name: Harmony Ridge
tags.description: Harmony Ridge is a long, groomed Blue with some steep sections that starts on Pika’s Traverse (Green) and ends down at Harmony Express Chairlift base.

tags.name: Burnt Stew Trail
tags.description: Burnt Stew Trail is the main Green run into Symphony Bowl.   It starts at the top of Harmony Express Chairlift, curves through Symphony Bowl and then exits out of Symphony Bowl back into the Harmony Express Chairlift area.

tags.name: Peak to Creek - Lower
tags.description: Lower Peak starts at the end of Upper Peak to Creek (Blue) and the start of Highway 86 (Blue).  Lower Peak runs down to Creekside base.

tags.name: Bagel Bowl
tags.description: Bagel Bowl is the smallest and easiest of the Whistler Peak bowls and is located on the Western edge of the Whistler Peak area.

tags.name: Whistler Bowl
tags.description: Whistler Bowl sits between West Bowl in the West and Glacier Bowl in the East.  Arguably it is the most famous of the 3 bowls as it runs underneath the top part of the Peak Express Chair and offers a wide range of Black (and some more difficult) runs.

tags.name: West Cirque Access
tags.description: The West Cirque is an extremely steep, difficult, Double Black run that drops into the Whistler Bowl and then joins up with Grand Finale (Black).   This run is accessible by following a path from Peak to Creek (Blue) to the edge of the bowl.

tags.name: Stephan's Chute
tags.description: Stefan’s Chute is a difficult, steep, narrow Double Black Chute on the left side (looking downhill) of West Bowl.   You can access it from Upper Peak to Creek (Blue) and the chute ends into West Bowl (Black).

tags.name: Cockalorum
tags.description: Cockalorum is the second highest entrance into West Bowl (Black) and is a difficult, steep Double Black that runs into West Bowl.  The entrance to this run is accessible from Upper Peak to Creek (Blue) and it exits down on to Highway 86 (Blue).

tags.name: Cream Cheese Ridge
tags.description: Cream Cheese Ridge (see the theme here?) is a steep, Black ridge run to the right of Bagel Roll (Black).   You can access it from Peak to Creek and it exits down into the bottom of West Bowl (Black) which then leads down to Highway 86 (Blue).

tags.name: Whistler Bowl
tags.description: Whistler Bowl has numerous routes that run down the middle and sides of the bowl leading down to Grande Finale (Black) or Doom & Gloom (Black).

tags.name: Monday's
tags.description: Monday’s is the highest entrance into West Bowl (Black) and is a difficult, steep Double Black that runs into West Bowl.  You can access this run from Upper Peak to Creek and it exits at the bottom through glades and mogul fields on to Highway 86 (Blue).

tags.name: Bagel Bowl
tags.description: Bagel Bowl is an easier, ungroomed, bumpy Black bowl on the Western edge of the Peak Express Chairlift Area.   You can access it from the side of the Upper Peak to Creek (Blue).

tags.name: Bagel Roll
tags.description: Bagel Roll is a steep, Black slope to the right side of Bagel Bowl (Black).   You can access it from Peak to Creek (Blue) and it exits down into the bottom of West Bowl (Black) which then leads down to Highway 86 (Blue).

tags.name: The Saddle
tags.description: The Saddle is a big, wide, steep Black run that starts at the end of Matthew’s Traverse (Green), goes down a steep section and then runs to the bottom of the Peak Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Jacob's Ladder
tags.description: Jacob’s Ladder is a Black that traverses across the top left (looking downhill) of Little Whistler Bowl (Black).  It then runs down along Little Whistler Ridge towards the top of the T-Bars.

tags.name: Glacier Bowl
tags.description: There are a series of routes down the left side (looking uphill) of the Glacier Bowl.   These routes are all accessible from Jacob’s Ladder (Black) that runs along Little Whistler Ridge.

tags.name: The Cirque
tags.description: The Cirque is an extremely steep, difficult, Double Black run that drops into the Whistler Glacier Bowl and ends down on Glacier Bowl (Blue).   The entrance is accessible from Matthew’s Traverse (Green) and is extremely narrow and rocky.

tags.name: The Couloir
tags.description: The Couloir is the other extremely steep, difficult, Double Black run that drops into the Whistler Glacier Bowl and ends on Glacier Bowl (Blue).   Similar to The Cirque (Double Black), this is accessible from Matthew’s Traverse (Green).

tags.name: Glacier Bowl
tags.description: The Glacier Bowl is the largest Bowl below Whistler Peak and is located above and the the left (looking uphill) of the bottom of the Peak Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Little Whistler
tags.description: Little Whistler Bowl is the small, steep, bumpy Black bowl below the top of the Harmony Express Chairlift and above Pika’s Traverse (Green).   You can access Little Whistler Bowl from below the top of the Harmony Express Chairlift and choose from a variet

tags.name: Little Whistler
tags.description: Little Whistler Bowl is the small, steep, bumpy Black bowl below the top of the Harmony Express Chairlift and above Pika’s Traverse (Green).   You can access Little Whistler Bowl from below the top of the Harmony Express Chairlift and choose from a variet

tags.name: Glacier Bowl
tags.description: There are a series of routes down the left side (looking uphill) of the Glacier Bowl.   These routes are all accessible from Jacob’s Ladder (Black) that runs along Little Whistler Ridge.

tags.name: Pika's Traverse
tags.description: Pika’s Traverse is a long Green that starts at the top of Harmony Express Chairlift, heads down along Harmony Ridge, turns left turn (looking downhill) and heads over towards the Roundhouse Lodge area.

tags.name: Burnt Stew Trail
tags.description: Burnt Stew Trail is the main Green run into Symphony Bowl.   It starts at the top of Harmony Express Chairlift, curves through Symphony Bowl and then exits out of Symphony Bowl back into the Harmony Express Chairlift area.

tags.name: Glacier Bowl
tags.description: There are a series of routes down the left side (looking uphill) of the Glacier Bowl.   These routes are all accessible from Jacob’s Ladder (Black) that runs along Little Whistler Ridge.

tags.name: Dusty's Descent
tags.description: Dusty’s Descent a bumpy, ungroomed Black run to the left side (looking downhill) of Lower Peak to Creek (Blue/Black).  It starts and ends on Lower Peak to Creek.

tags.name: Upper Kadenwood Trail
tags.description: Similar to Lower Kadenwood Trail (Blue), Upper Kadenwood Trail is a narrow, connector Blue that starts on the left side (looking downhill) of Lower Kadenwood Trail (Blue), cross Lower Peak (Blue) and runs over to the Kadenwood homes neighborhood.

tags.name: Upper Kadenwood Trail
tags.description: Similar to Lower Kadenwood Trail (Blue), Upper Kadenwood Trail is a narrow, connector Blue that starts on the left side (looking downhill) of Lower Kadenwood Trail (Blue), cross Lower Peak (Blue) and runs over to the Kadenwood homes neighborhood.

tags.name: Home Run
tags.piste:name: Home Run
tags.description: Home Run is a narrow Black that runs from Big Timber into the Kadenwood neighborhood.

tags.name: Lower Kadenwood Trail
tags.description: Lower Kadenwood Trail is a long, narrow, connector Blue that starts on the left side (looking downhill) of Lower Dave Murray Downhill (Black), cross Lower Franz’s (Blue) and Lower Peak to Creek (Blue) and runs over to the Kadenwood homes neighborhood.

tags.name: West Bowl
tags.description: West Bowl is a large Black Bowl below and to the West of Whistler Peak.   It is known for its Double Black Runs, steep lines and powder snow.

tags.name: West Bowl
tags.description: West Bowl is a large Black Bowl below and to the West of Whistler Peak.   It is known for its Double Black Runs, steep lines and powder snow.

tags.name: West Cirque
tags.description: The West Cirque is an extremely steep, difficult, Double Black run that drops into the Whistler Bowl and then joins up with Grand Finale (Black).   This run is accessible by following a path from Peak to Creek (Blue) to the edge of the bowl.

tags.name: Sunrise
tags.description: Sunrise is a steep, difficult Double Black that runs down from West Ridge (Black) down into Whistler Bowl (Black).

tags.name: Grande Finale
tags.description: Grande Finale is a Black that starts in the middle bottom of Whistler Bowl and then curves down to Highway 86 (Blue).   The bottom 1/3rd of the run above Highway 86 is a large mogul field.

tags.name: Sneaky Pete
tags.description: Sneaky Pete is a Black traverse run from Whistler Bowl (Black) over to the West Ridge (Black).   It starts in Whistler Bowl and runs over to give access to West Bowl (Black) and also the West Ridge (Black) run.

tags.name: Gloom
tags.description: Doom & Gloom are 2 Blacks that run down the middle and side of the terminal moraine near the bottom of the Whistler Bowl.  Both are accessible from the Whistler Bowl (Black) and both end on Grande Finale (Black).

tags.name: West Ridge
tags.description: West Ridge is a Black that runs across the top of the ridge between Whistler Bowl and West Bowl.   It starts from the Sneaky Pete traverse (Black)  and runs down the ridge to end at the top of Frog Hollow (Black).

tags.name: Escalator
tags.description: Escalator is a short, steep Black that starts near the end of West Ridge (Black) and runs down into the bottom of Whistler Bowl, ending on Grande Finale (Black).

tags.name: Whistler Bowl
tags.description: Whistler Bowl has numerous routes that run down the middle and sides of the bowl leading down to Grande Finale (Black) or Doom & Gloom (Black).

tags.name: Frog Hollow
tags.description: Frog Hollow is area of Black glade skiing that starts at the end of the West Ridge (Black).   Depending upon which path you take you will exit Frog Hollow either onto Grand Finale (Black) or Highway 86 (Blue).

tags.name: Doom
tags.description: Doom & Gloom are 2 Blacks that run down the middle and side of the terminal moraine near the bottom of the Whistler Bowl.  Both are accessible from the Whistler Bowl (Black) and both end on Grande Finale (Black).

tags.name: Whistler Bowl
tags.description: Whistler Bowl has numerous routes that run down the middle and sides of the bowl leading down to Grande Finale (Black) or Doom & Gloom (Black).

tags.name: Alley Bear
tags.description: Alley Bear is a steep Black that runs down the left side (looking downhill) of Whistler Bowl (Black).  It starts from near the end of the East Ridge (Black) and runs down to Grande Finale (Black).

tags.name: West Bowl
tags.description: West Bowl is a large Black Bowl below and to the West of Whistler Peak.   It is known for its Double Black Runs, steep lines and powder snow.

tags.name: The Coffin
tags.description: The Coffin is an extremely difficult, narrow Triple Black chute just below the Peak Express Chairlift.  It gets its name from how narrow it is (just about one body wide).

tags.name: Shale Chute
tags.description: Shale Chute is the narrow Black chute / gully on the left side (looking downhill) of Shale Slope (Black).  It is accessible from East Ridge (Black) and runs down to the Peak Express Chairlift base.

tags.name: East Ridge
tags.description: East Ridge is a Black run that travels across the top of the East Ridge of Whistler Bowl.   You can access it from several points in Whistler Bowl and it provides access to runs into Whistler and Glacier Bowls.

tags.name: Ego Bowl
tags.description: Ego Bowl is the main Green that runs from near the top of Emerald Express Chairlift down through this area to the bottom of the Emerald Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Jolly Green Giant
tags.description: Jolly Green Giant is the main, long Blue that runs from the top of Emerald Express Chairlift / Roundhouse lodge area down to Sidewinder (Green) near the bottom of the Emerald Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Fisheye
tags.description: Fisheye is a Blue that runs down from just below Roundhouse Lodge, crosses Pony Trail - Upper and ends down on Porcupine.

tags.name: Little Red Run
tags.description: Little Red Run is a Blue that starts at the top of the Big Red Express Chairlift, merges with Pony Trail - Upper for a stretch and ends down to end on Fisheye.  Fisheye connects with Papoose (green) that then runs over to the top of Franz’s run (Blue).

tags.name: Pony Trail - Upper
tags.description: Pony Trail is the main Green that runs in a large S curve down from Roundhouse Lodge area down to Big Red Express Chairlift base.  This upper section runs from Roundhouse down to Papoose.

tags.name: East Ridge
tags.description: East Ridge is a Black run that travels across the top of the East Ridge of Whistler Bowl.   You can access it from several points in Whistler Bowl and it provides access to runs into Whistler and Glacier Bowls.

tags.name: Shale Slope
tags.description: Shale Slope is the wide, bumpy Black above and to the right of Peak Express Chairlift base.  It is accessible from East Ridge (Black) and runs down to the Peak Express Chairlift base

tags.name: Ridge Run
tags.description: Ridge Run is a short Blue that runs across the ridge above and to the left of the T-Bar and ends at the top of the Emerald Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Headwall
tags.description: Headwall is a short, steep Black wall that drops down from Ridge Run (Blue) and ends at the bottom of the T-bar.   You can also access Headwall from the top of the Big Red Express Chairlift.

tags.name: T-Bar Run
tags.description: The T-Bar Run is a wide Blue that runs down beside the T-Bar.

tags.name: Upper Whiskey Jack
tags.description: Upper Whiskey Jack is a Green trail that runs from below Roundhouse Lodge down to the Chickpea Hut area.  It connects with Papoose which leads down into the Big Red Express Chair area.

tags.name: Pale Face
tags.description: Paleface is a short, bumpy Black similar to CC (Black) and can be accessed below and behind Roundhouse Lodge and under the Whistler Village Gondola.  It ends down on Pony Trail (Green).

tags.name: Franz's Meadows
tags.description: Franz’s Meadow is a small, ungroomed Black Bowl below the Air Jordan and Waterfall Cliffs.   You can access this bowl by following Old Man (Blue) around the top of the snowmaking reservoir and then traversing along under the cliffs.

tags.name: Old Man
tags.description: Old Man is an ungroomed, bumpy Blue that runs from Peak Express Chairlift base around both sides of the snowmaking water reservoir and then down towards the top of Franz’s run (Blue).

tags.name: Pale Face
tags.description: Paleface is a short, bumpy Black similar to CC (Black) and can be accessed below and behind Roundhouse Lodge and under the Whistler Village Gondola.  It ends down on Pony Trail (Green).

tags.name: Left Hook
tags.description: Left Hook is the right most of the bumpy Black runs above and to the right (looking uphill) of Peak Express Chairlift base.  It is accessible from East Ridge (Black) and runs down to Peak Express Chairlift base.

tags.name: Headwall
tags.description: Headwall is a short, steep Black wall that drops down from Ridge Run (Blue) and ends at the bottom of the T-bar.   You can also access Headwall from the top of the Big Red Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Lower Roundhouse Roll
tags.description: Lower Roundhouse Roll is the continuation of Roundhouse Roll below Lower Whiskey Jack (Green).  It starts on the right side (looking downhill) of Whiskey Jack and ends down on Ego Bowl (Green).

tags.name: Surprise
tags.description: Surprise is steep, bumpy Black that runs down the slope below the Coffin (Triple Black).  It is accessible from either The Coffin or North Face (Black) and ends on Glacier Bowl (Blue) that runs back down to Peak Express Chairlift base

tags.name: Franz's Meadows
tags.description: Franz’s Meadow is a small, ungroomed Black Bowl below the Air Jordan and Waterfall Cliffs.   You can access this bowl by following Old Man (Blue) around the top of the snowmaking reservoir and then traversing along under the cliffs.

tags.name: Key West
tags.description: Key West is a Black that runs between Left Hook and Waterfall Cliffs and Shale Chute.

tags.name: Come Chute
tags.description: Come Chute is a steep, rocky chute that drop from the end of East Ridge down into Franz's Meadows.

tags.name: Waterfall Cliffs Drop
tags.description: Waterfall Cliffs is a line of cliffs to the right of Peak Express Chairlift base and is the smaller sibling of Air Jordan (Triple Black) above it.  It is accessible via Whistler Bowl Run (Black) and then Left Hook (Black).

tags.name: Air Jordan Drop
tags.description: Air Jordan is a Triple Black drop off of a high cliff above and Waterfall Cliffs.  It has drops of 40 to 50 ft with only a small landing area below the cliff.   It is accessible from East Ridge (Black) and then by continuing along the ridge above Left Hoo

tags.name: Tiger's Terrace
tags.description: Tiger's Terrace is a series of routes down through steep glades above Old Man and Franz's Meadows.   Access to these routes is from East Ridge above.

tags.name: Peak Traverse
tags.description: Peak Traverse is a Green that runs from the Roundhouse Lodge over to the bottom of the Peak Express Chairlift.  From the bottom of the chairlift it turns right along side the reservoir and ends down on Pont Trail - Upper.

tags.name: Closed Captions
tags.description: Closed Captions is a set of short ungroomed & bumpy runs behind and below the Roundhouse Lodge and to the left of Whistler Village Gondola.  All the CC runs end on Pony Trail (Green).

tags.name: Closed Captions
tags.description: Closed Captions is a set of short ungroomed & bumpy runs behind and below the Roundhouse Lodge and to the left of Whistler Village Gondola.  All the CC runs end on Pony Trail (Green).

tags.name: Closed Captions
tags.description: Closed Captions is a set of short ungroomed & bumpy runs behind and below the Roundhouse Lodge and to the left of Whistler Village Gondola.  All the CC runs end on Pony Trail (Green).

tags.name: Closed Captions
tags.description: Closed Captions is a small off-piste area below Roundhouse Lodge.  With fresh snow, this is a fun area of fluffy bumps.

tags.name: Wild Card
tags.description: Wildcard is a steep Black mogul run between Bear Cub (Green) at the top and Highway 86 (Blue) on the bottom.   This run was where the women’s alpine downhill races started during the 2010 Olympics.

tags.name: Jimmy's Joker
tags.description: Jimmy’s Joker is a short, steep Black mogul run between Bear Cub (Green) at the top and Pony Trail (Green) on the bottom.

tags.name: Bear Cub - Lower
tags.description: Bear Cub is a long, flat Green that runs from the bottom of Franz’s Chairlift down to the Big Red Express Chairlift base area.  This lower section runs from Pony Trail - Middle down to the bottom of the Big Red Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Cross Roads
tags.description: Crossroad is a narrow Blue that runs from Expressway (Green), under the Creekside Gondola and over to connect with Franz's - Middle run (Blue)

tags.name: Goat's Gully
tags.piste:name: Goat's Gully
tags.description: Goats Gully is steep, bumpy Black mogul run that drops from Bear Cub (Green) down to the bottom of Big Red Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Insanity
tags.description: The lower half of Insanity is a Double Black that runs from the top of the Creekside Gondola down under the Gondola, crosses Cross Roads (Blue) and ends down on the Dave Murray Downhill run (Black).

tags.name: Insanity
tags.description: The upper half of Insanity is a Double Black runs down from Pony Trail (Green), under the Big Red Express Chairlift to Big Red Express Chairlift Base.

tags.name: Dave Murray Downhill - Upper
tags.description: Dave Murray Downhill - Upper is a big, wide Black run that starts just below the top of Garbanzo Express Chairlift and runs down to Expressway (Green) where it turns into the Lower Dave Murray Downhill (Black).

tags.name: Bear Cub - Upper
tags.description: Bear Cub is a long, flat Green that runs from the bottom of Franz’s Chairlift down to the Big Red Express Chairlift base area.  This upper section runs from Franz's Chairlift down to Pony Trail - Middle.

tags.name: Papoose
tags.description: Papoose is a Green that runs from the Chickpea Hut area over towards the top of Franz’s run (Blue).

tags.name: Pig Alley
tags.description: Pig Alley is a short, easy Green that runs from the Chickpea Hut area over to the Ego Bowl run (Green).

tags.name: Papoose
tags.description: Papoose is a Green that runs from the Chickpea Hut area over towards the top of Franz’s run (Blue).

tags.name: Cougar
tags.description: Cougar is a short, bumpy Blue with a steep-ish slope between Ego Bowl (Green) at the top and Jolly Green Giant (Blue) at the bottom.

tags.name: Banana Peel
tags.description: Banana Peel is a short Green that runs from the Chickpea Hut area, crosses Pony Trail (Green) and ends at Bear Cub (Green).   If you continue straight, this run turns into Jimmy’s Joker (Black).

tags.name: Orange Peel
tags.description: Orange Peel is a short Blue that runs from the top of Garbanzo Express Chairlift, meets with Pony Trail (Green) and then continues to end on Upper Dave Murray Downhill (Black).

tags.name: Ptarmigan
tags.description: Ptarmigan is a long Blue that runs from the right side of Raven down to end at the top of the Olympic Chairlift.

tags.name: Emerald Forest
tags.description: Emerald Forest is a wide Blue that starts from the Chickpea Hut area and goes down to Ego Bowl (Green).    Enchanted Forest has a secondary start at the bottom of Pig Alley (Green) which drops down to connect with the main run below.

tags.name: Lower Whiskey Jack
tags.description: Lower Whiskey Jack is a long, wide Green that runs from the Chickpea Hut area (below the top of Garbanzo Express Chairlift) down to connect with Upper Olympic (Green) near the Emerald Express Chairlift base.

tags.name: Emerald Forest
tags.description: Emerald Forest is a wide Blue that starts from the Chickpea Hut area and goes down to Ego Bowl (Green).    Enchanted Forest has a secondary start at the bottom of Pig Alley (Green) which drops down to connect with the main run below.

tags.name: Old Crow
tags.description: Old Crow is a short Blue that runs from the left side of Lower Whiskey Jack down to end on Lower Whiskey Jack (Green) further downhill.

tags.name: Olympic - Upper
tags.description: Olympic - Upper is the big, wide main Green that runs from Emerald Express Chairlift base down to the Olympic Mid Station area (where it connects with Lower Olympic (Green) that leads into the village).

tags.name: Papoose
tags.description: Papoose is a Green that runs from the Chickpea Hut area over towards the top of Franz’s run (Blue).

tags.name: Garbonzo Express Chairlift Line
tags.description: This is an unmarked Black “run” under the Garbanzo Express Chairlift.  It is ungroomed with big bumps, drops, cliffs and steep sections.

tags.name: Raven
tags.description: Raven is short Black run immediately to the left (looking downhill) of the top of the Garbanzo Express Chairlift.   It runs down to connect with Ptarmigan (Blue).

tags.name: Lemon Peel
tags.description: Orange Peel is a short Blue that runs from the top of Garbanzo Express Chairlift, meets with Pony Trail (Green) and then continues to end on Upper Dave Murray Downhill (Black).

tags.name: Ptarmigan
tags.description: Ptarmigan is a long Blue that runs from the right side of Raven down to end at the top of the Olympic Chairlift.

tags.name: Pony Trail - Middle
tags.description: Pony Trail is the main Green that runs in a large S curve down from Roundhouse Lodge area down to Big Red Express Chairlift base.  This upper section runs from Roundhouse down to Papoose.

tags.name: Whistler Tree Fort
tags.description: The Whistler Tree Fort is a kids fort that sits in the forest between Bear Cub (Green) and Pony Trail (Green).

tags.name: Jeff's Ode To Joy
tags.description: Jeff’s Ode to Joy is the big, wide, groomed Blue that runs from the top of the Symphony Express Chairlift down through Harmony Bowl to the bottom of the Harmony Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Rhapsody Bowl
tags.description: Rhapsody Bowl a big, ungroomed Blue alpine bowl below the Flute Summit.   It ends in the Glissando Glades (Blue) area which leads down to the bottom of the Symphony Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Piccolo North Face
tags.description: Piccolo North Face a very difficult, steep, bumpy Black face below the top of the Symphony Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Piccolo Summit Traverse
tags.description: x

tags.name: Flute Summit Access Path
tags.description: The Flute Summit Access Path is the route up the right side (looking uphill) of the Flute Summit.  To get the summit either takes skis with climbing skins or a 15+/- minute book hike up the path.

tags.name: Last Resort
tags.description: Last Resort is a long, narrow Green that starts in the 7th Heaven area and runs into the Catskinner Chair area where it joins with Easy Out (Green).

tags.name: Encore Ridge
tags.description: Encore Ridge is a long, Black run that curves back down from Flute Summit to the the bottom of the Symphony Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Flute Shoulder
tags.description: Flute Shoulder is a Double Black route between the Flute Main Bowl and the Flute North Bowl.  It starts with an easy roll entrance and then has an increasingly steep slope that exits into Rhapsody Bowl (Blue) below.

tags.name: Flute North Bowl
tags.description: The Flute North Bowl is the 2nd and largest Flute Bowl area sitting below the Flute Summit.  This is a Double Black area with steep entrances over the cornice.   This area exits down into Rhapsody Bowl (Blue).

tags.name: North Bowl Cornice
tags.description: The North Bowl Cornice is the Double Black entrance into the North Flute Bowl that is furthest down Encore Ridge (Blue).  This routes starts with a steep entrance over the cornice and exits down into Rhapsody Bowl (Blue).

tags.name: Big O
tags.description: The Big O is Double Black Route that runs across the ridge between North Flute Bowl and the Lesser Flute Bowl.  At the end of the ridge, you can then either go left or right into either bowl.  Both routes exit down into Rhapsody Bowl (Blue).

tags.name: Lesser Flute Bowl
tags.description: Lesser Flute Bowl is the smallest bowl in the 3 Flute Bowls.   This is also the last bowl area accessible from Encore Ridge (Black) before it descends into the treeline and exits into Glissando Glades (Blue).

tags.name: Moraine
tags.description: The Moraine is a Black route that runs down the front of the moraine that is located in the middle bottom of the Main Flute Bowl.   It exits down into Rhapsody Bowl (Blue).

Flute Chutes
tags.description: The Flute Chutes are a pair of Triple Black chutes that are considered the hardest entrance into any of the Flute Bowls.   Access is over a cornice into a very steep, rocky chute.  These chutes exit down into Rhapsody Bowl (Blue).

tags.name: Flute Chutes
tags.description: The Flute Chutes are a pair of Triple Black chutes that are considered the hardest entrance into any of the Flute Bowls.   Access is over a cornice into a very steep, rocky chute.  These chutes exit down into Rhapsody Bowl (Blue).

tags.name: Flute North Bowl
tags.description: The Flute North Bowl is the 2nd and largest Flute Bowl area sitting below the Flute Summit.  This is a Double Black area with steep entrances over the cornice.   This area exits down into Rhapsody Bowl (Blue).

tags.name: Piccolo Main
tags.description: Piccolo Main is a steep, bumpy Black face that is easier of the 3 routes down the front of Piccolo Summit at the top of the Symphony Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Sun Bowl
tags.description: Sun Bowl is wonderful, small, bumpy Black bowl that leads down into Harmony Bowl. You can access Sun Bowl at the top from Pika's Traverse (Green) and can exit down to Burnt Stew Trail (Green).

tags.name: Crescendo
tags.description: Crescendo is large, ungroomed Black area below Burnt Stew Trail (Green).   This run is steep initially, flat in the middle, drops down a steep mogul face before ending on Jeff’s Ode to Joy (Blue).

tags.name: Safe Route
tags.description: Safe Route is the easiest Black entrance from Harmony Ridge (Blue) into Harmony Horseshoe Bowl below.  You can access this run at the top from Harmony Ridge (Blue) and exit at the bottom on to Harmony Piste run (Blue).

tags.name: Harmony Piste
tags.description: Harmony Piste is a Blue run that curves down through the middle of Harmony Bowl. It starts on the right of Pika's Traverse (Green), curves downhill and swings left across the middle of Harmony Bowl and ends on GS Run.

tags.name: Hidden Chute
tags.description: Hidden Chute is another steep Black route into Symphony Bowl from Harmony Ridge (Blue).   It is called Hidden Chute as you need to ski across a flat section to see the top of the chute).  It exits on to Burnt Stew Trail (Green).

tags.name: Harvey's
tags.description: Harvey’s is one of routes into Symphony Bowl from Harmony Ridge (Blue).   It is a steep, bumpy Black at the top with glades at the bottom.  It exits at the bottom on to Burnt Stew Trail (Green)

tags.name: Horseshoe 4
tags.description: The Horseshoe Bowl Entrances are Double Black chute / cornice entrances into the Harmony Horseshoe Bowl. All of the Horseshoe chute entrances are accessible from Harmony Ridge run (Blue).

tags.name: Low Roll
tags.description: Low Roll is one of the 3 easier, Black entrances into the Lower Horseshoe Bowl.  It sits between Safe Route (Black) and KC Role (Double Black).   You can access Low Roll from Harmony Ridge (Blue) and exit on to Harmony Piste (Blue) at the bottom.

tags.name: Kaleidoscope
tags.description: Kaleidoscope is a short, ungroomed Black run into the Lower Horseshoe Bowl above the Krummholz (Blue) run.  You can access this run at the top from Harmony Ridge (Blue) and exit onto Krummholtz (Blue) at the bottom.

tags.name: KC Roll
tags.description: KC Roll is a short, steep, bumpy Double Black chute with a steep entrance into Lower Horseshoe Bowl between Kaleidescope (Black) and Low Roll (Black).  Access at the top from Harmony Ridge (Blue) and exit onto Krummholtz (Blue) at the bottom.

tags.name: Big Daddy
tags.description: Big Daddy is an unmarked Black run that curves down from Harmony Piste (Blue) through the off piste area in the middle of Harmony Bowl and then ends up back on Harmony Piste further down the Bowl.

tags.name: Big Daddy
tags.description: Big Daddy is an unmarked Black run that curves down from Harmony Piste (Blue) through the off piste area in the middle of Harmony Bowl and then ends up back on Harmony Piste further down the Bowl.

tags.name: Staccato Glades
tags.description: The Staccato Glades is an area of short Blue glades accessible from the right side of Adagio (Blue).   These glades end into the Rhapsody Bowl (Blue) / Glissando Glades (Blue) area.

tags.name: Piccolo Summit Slope
tags.description: Similar to Piccolo North Face (Double Black), Piccolo Summit Slope a very steep, bumpy Double Black face below the Piccolo Summit.

tags.name: Hidden Chute
tags.description: Hidden Chute is another steep Black route into Symphony Bowl from Harmony Ridge (Blue).   It is called Hidden Chute as you need to ski across a flat section to see the top of the chute).  It exits on to Burnt Stew Trail (Green).

tags.name: Horseshoe Bowl
tags.description: Horseshoe Bowl is the wide open, ungroomed, Black bowl area below Harmony Ridge.

tags.name: Sender Chute
tags.description: Sender Chute is a very narrow, steep and challenge Double Black (maybe even Triple Black) chute in the cliff above Lower Horseshoe Bowl.   Access is from Harmony Ridge and the exit is down onto Harmony Piste.

tags.name: Sun Bowl Chutes
tags.description: The Sun Bowl Chutes are a couple of steep, narrow Black chutes in the cliff face to right of Sun Bowl (Black).  Access these chutes next to the top of the Sun Bowl entrance.   These chutes exit on to the bottom of the Sun Bowl.

tags.name: Sun Bowl Chutes
tags.description: The Sun Bowl Chutes are a couple of steep, narrow Black chutes in the cliff face to right of Sun Bowl (Black).  Access these chutes next to the top of the Sun Bowl entrance.   These chutes exit on to the bottom of the Sun Bowl.

tags.name: Horseshoe 7
tags.description: The Horseshoe Bowl Entrances are Double Black chute / cornice entrances into the Harmony Horseshoe Bowl. All of the Horseshoe chute entrances are accessible from Harmony Ridge run (Blue).

tags.name: Horseshoe 6
tags.description: The Horseshoe Bowl Entrances are Double Black chute / cornice entrances into the Harmony Horseshoe Bowl. All of the Horseshoe chute entrances are accessible from Harmony Ridge run (Blue).

tags.name: Horseshoe 8
tags.description: The Horseshoe Bowl Entrances are Double Black chute / cornice entrances into the Harmony Horseshoe Bowl. All of the Horseshoe chute entrances are accessible from Harmony Ridge run (Blue).

tags.name: Horseshoe 5
tags.description: Horseshoe 5 (H5) is considered to be the most difficult of the Double Black Horseshoe Bowl Entrances.  It is accessible from Harmony Ridge run (Blue).

tags.name: Horseshoe 1
tags.description: The Horseshoe Bowl Entrances are Double Black chute / cornice entrances into the Harmony Horseshoe Bowl. All of the Horseshoe chute entrances are accessible from Harmony Ridge run (Blue).

tags.name: Horseshoe 3
tags.description: The Horseshoe Bowl Entrances are Double Black chute / cornice entrances into the Harmony Horseshoe Bowl. All of the Horseshoe chute entrances are accessible from Harmony Ridge run (Blue).

tags.name: Glissando Glades
tags.description: The Glissando Glades is an area of relatively flat, Blue glades at the bottom of Rhapsody Bowl (Blue).  There is normally a narrow, groomed path through this area leading down to the bottom of the Symphony Express Chairlift.

tags.name: The Glades
tags.description: The Glades is an ungroomed, Blue alpine (smaller tree) glade run on the right side (looking downhill) of Harmony Ridge.  The Glades starts on the right side of Harmony Ridge (Blue) and exits back on to it further down the hill.

tags.name: Jeff's Ode To Joy
tags.description: Jeff’s Ode to Joy is the big, wide, groomed Blue that runs from the top of the Symphony Express Chairlift down through Harmony Bowl to the bottom of the Harmony Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Glissando Glades
tags.description: The Glissando Glades is an area of relatively flat, Blue glades at the bottom of Rhapsody Bowl (Blue).  There is normally a narrow, groomed path through this area leading down to the bottom of the Symphony Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Staccato Glades
tags.description: The Staccato Glades is an area of short Blue glades accessible from the right side of Adagio (Blue).   These glades end into the Rhapsody Bowl (Blue) / Glissando Glades (Blue) area.

tags.name: Robertson's
tags.description: Robertson’s is another route into Symphony Bowl from Harmony Ridge (Blue).   It is a steep, bumpy Black chute at the top with old growth tree glades at the bottom.  It exits at the bottom down a steep slope on to Burnt Stew Trail (Green).

tags.name: Rabbit Tracks
tags.description: Rabbit Tracks is a short, ungroomed Blue that runs from below the end of Pika’s Traverse (Green) to to meet up with GS Run (Blue).

tags.name: Stagger Home Chute
tags.description: Staggerhome Chute is a very steep, rocky Double Black chute below Ridge Run (Blue) and above Pika’s Traverse (Green).

tags.name: GS Start
tags.description: GS Start is a short, bumpy Black roll just below Ridge Run (Blue) and above Pika’s Traverse (Green).   You can access this run at the top from Ridge Run and exit on to Pika’s Traverse at the bottom.

tags.name: Die Hard
tags.description: Die Hard is a steep, ungroomed Black area that spills over the smoother left end (looking uphill) of Harmony Waterfall Ridge (Double Black).  It starts on the right side (looking downhill) of Pika’s Traverse (Green) and then runs down to meet with the GS

tags.name: Die Hard Start
tags.description: DH Start is a short, steep, bumpy Black face just below Ridge Run (Blue) and above Pika’s Traverse (Green).   You can access Die Hard Start at the top from Ridge Run and exit on to Pika’s Traverse at the bottom.

tags.name: Die Hard
tags.description: Die Hard is a steep, ungroomed Black area that spills over the smoother left end (looking uphill) of Harmony Waterfall Ridge (Double Black).  It starts on the right side (looking downhill) of Pika’s Traverse (Green) and then runs down to meet with the GS

tags.name: Boot Chutes
tags.description: Boot Chutes are 2 parallel, narrow Black chutes between the trees on the slope beside Lower McConkey’s run (Black).   Access to Boot Chutes is from Harmony Piste run (Blue) just past the entrance to Lower McConkey’s run (Black).

tags.name: Boot Chutes
tags.description: Boot Chutes are 2 parallel, narrow Black chutes between the trees on the slope beside Lower McConkey’s run (Black).   Access to Boot Chutes is from Harmony Piste run (Blue) just past the entrance to Lower McConkey’s run (Black).

tags.name: Big Daddy
tags.description: Big Daddy is an unmarked Black run that curves down from Harmony Piste (Blue) through the off piste area in the middle of Harmony Bowl and then ends up back on Harmony Piste further down the Bowl.

tags.name: Lower McConkey's
tags.description: Lower McConkey’s a wide, steep Black mogul run that starts at the top from Krummholtz (Blue) and runs down to Harmony Express Chairlift base.   Lower McConkey’s is famous for its big, steep moguls.

tags.name: GS Run
tags.description: The GS Run is a Blue that runs from the top of Emerald Express Chairlift down to the bottom of the Harmony Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Marmot
tags.description: Marmot is a narrow Green that runs from Jolly Green Giant (Blue) over to the bottom of the Harmony Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Ratfink
tags.description: Ratfink is a Black mogul run with a wide steep face at the top and a narrower mogul run at the bottom.   To Access Ratfink, head downhill for the ridge of trees half way between Jolly Green Giant (Blue) on the left and GS Run (Blue) on the right.

tags.name: Lower Ratfink
tags.description: Lower Ratfink is the lower, Green section below the bumpy Ratfink (Black) run above.  It runs between Marmot (Green) at top and Sidewinder (Green) at the bottom.

tags.name: Krummholtz
tags.description: Krummholtz is a short Blue that connects Harmony Ridge (Blue) with Harmony Piste (Blue).  It runs below Kaleidoscope (Black) and KC Roll (Double Black) above and Boomer Bowl (Black) below.

tags.name: Green Acres
tags.description: Green Acres is a big, wide Blue that runs from the side of Jolly Green Giant (Blue) below the top of the Emerald Express Chairlift down to Sidewinder (Green) at the bottom.

tags.name: Chunky's Choice
tags.description: Chunky’s Choice is a well known Black mogul run that goes from GS Run (Blue) down to the bottom of the Harmony Express Chairlift.  Chunky’s Choice crosses Harmony Piste (Blue) which you can take over to Sidewinder (Green).

tags.name: Sidewinder
tags.description: Sidewinder is a long, flat Green that runs from the bottom of the Harmony Express Chairlift over to the bottom of the Emerald Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Water Face
tags.description: Waterface is one of the 2 short, steep runs / drops on the left side (looking uphill) of Harmony Waterfall Ridge (Double Black).

tags.name: Bitter End
tags.description: Bitter End is one of the 2 short, steep runs / drops on the left side (looking uphill) of Harmony Waterfall Ridge (Double Black).  It runs parallel to and just below to the right of the Harmony Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Lower McConkey's
tags.description: Lower McConkey’s a wide, steep Black mogul run that starts at the top from Krummholtz (Blue) and runs down to Harmony Express Chairlift base.   Lower McConkey’s is famous for its big, steep moguls.

tags.name: Boomer Bowl
tags.description: Boomer Bowl is a Black bowl on the left side (looking uphill) of Harmony Bowl.  It is ungroomed and normally bumpy but can be quite fun with good / fresh snow.   You can access it either from Harmony Ridge (Blue) or Krumholtz (Blue) that run above it.  Ex

tags.name: Harmony Chairlift Line
tags.description: Starting at Harmony Piste (Blue) and running under the Harmony Express Chairlift there is an unmarked, ungroomed, bumpy Black “run” with steep sections, drops and trees.

tags.name: Lower Horseshoe Bowl
tags.description: Lower Horseshoe Bowl is the smaller, ungroomed, Black bowl area below the middle of Harmony Ridge.

tags.name: Dapper's Delight
tags.description: Dapper's Delight is a narrow bump run that follows the path of the former Blue Chairlift that use to run up this area.

tags.name: Wet Dreams
tags.description: Wet Dreams is a challenging, ungroomed Black glade area at the bottom and right of Boomer Bowl (Black).  You can access this area from the bottom of Boomer Bowl and exit at the bottom is on to the end of the Gun Barrels (Black).

tags.name: Gun Barrels
tags.description: The Gun Barrels are 2 narrow, steep Black chutes that run down one side of Boomer Bowl (Black).  Access to the Gun Barrels is from the left of Harmony Ridge run (Blue) and they exit down to the bottom of the Harmony Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Boomer Bowl
tags.description: Boomer Bowl is a Black bowl on the left side (looking uphill) of Harmony Bowl.  It is ungroomed and normally bumpy but can be quite fun with good / fresh snow.   You can access it either from Harmony Ridge (Blue) or Krumholtz (Blue) that run above it.  Ex

tags.name: Gun Barrels
tags.description: The Gun Barrels are 2 narrow, steep Black chutes that run down one side of Boomer Bowl (Black).  Access to the Gun Barrels is from the left of Harmony Ridge run (Blue) and they exit down to the bottom of the Harmony Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Coyote
tags.description: Coyote is a short, bumpy Blue version of Bobcat (Blue) between Green Acres (Blue) at the top and Sidewinder (Green) at the bottom.

tags.name: Bobcat
tags.description: Bobcat is a Blue that runs through the Emerald Express Chairlift area.  Bobcat starts on Jolly Green Giant (Blue), goes through the the Whistler Terrain Park and continues to a mogul section at the bottom where it ends on Sidewinder (Green).

tags.name: Zudrell's
tags.description: Zudrell is an unmarked, bumpy Black run with trees and other terrain features that runs under the Peak to Peak Gondola from Marmot (Green) down to Sidewinder (Green).

tags.name: Enchanted Forest Adventure Zone
tags.description: Enchanted Forest Adventure Zone is a glade area between Ego Bowl (Green) and Emerald Forest (Blue) run.  There are several paths cut through it for kids to be able to ski through the glade area with safety (Blue difficulty).

tags.name: School Yard
tags.description: The School Yard is a short, wide Green that starts on the right side (looking downhill) of Ego Bowl (Green) and runs down to the bottom of the Emerald Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Bean Sprout
tags.description: Bean Sprout is a short Blue that starts at the bottom of Chipmunk / on the side of Ego Bowl and curves down to end at the bottom of the Emerald Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Raptor's Ride
tags.description: Raptor’s Ride is the longest of the 4, bumpy Black glade runs that start on Expressway (Green) and lead down to Sunset Boulevard (Green).   The trees on this run are well spaced and with fresh snow this can be a wonderful fluffy bump glade run!

tags.name: Hugh's Heaven
tags.description: Hugh’s Heaven is a big, wide, steep, groomed Blue that runs down through 7th Heaven area. It starts at the same bend in Greenline (Green) where Cloud Nine starts, runs parallel to Cloud Nine and ends at the bottom of the 7th Heaven Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Where's Joe
tags.description: Similar to Raptor’s Ride and Watch Out, Where’s Joe is a shorter bumpy black glade that starts on Expressway (Green) and leads down to Sunset Boulevard (Green).

tags.name: Yard Sale
tags.description: Yard Sale is the final and shortest of the 4 bumpy Black glade runs that start on Expressway (Green) and leads down to Sunset Boulevard (Green)

tags.name: Sunburn
tags.description: Sunburn is a Black mogul run and is the sibling of Angel Dust (Black).   Access to the top of Sunburn and Angel Dust (which start at the same point) is from the right side (looking downhill) of Hugh’s Heaven.   It goes down to the bottom of the 7th Heaven

tags.name: Everglades
tags.description: The Everglades is a wide area of Black glade skiing that runs from Greenline (Green) above down to 7th Avenue (Green) below.

tags.name: 7th Avenue
tags.description: 7th Avenue is a long, narrow, relatively flat Green that runs from near the top of the Jersey Cream Express Chairlift, around the side of mountain and down to the lower sections of the 3 big Blues in the 7th Heaven area, ending on Cloud Nine (Blue).

tags.name: Cloud Nine
tags.description: Cloud Nine is a big, wide, steep Blue that run down through the 7th Heaven. It starts at the first bend in Greenline (Green) where it comes down from the top of 7th Heaven Express Chairlift and ends down at the bottom of the 7th Heaven Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Panorama
tags.description: Panorama is a big, steep Blue on 7th Heaven.  It starts at the 2nd bend of Greeline (Green), curves under the 7th Heaven Express Chairlift and ends at the bottom of the 7th Heaven Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Everglades
tags.description: The Everglades is a wide area of Black glade skiing that runs from Greenline (Green) above down to 7th Avenue (Green) below.

tags.name: Everglades
tags.description: The Everglades is a wide area of Black glade skiing that runs from Greenline (Green) above down to 7th Avenue (Green) below.

tags.name: Expressway
tags.description: Expressway is a long, narrow, relatively flat Green that runs from near the top of the Catskinner Chairlift / Rendezvous Lodge area, around the mountain and down to the bottom of the 7th Heaven Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Watch Out
tags.description: Watch Out is similar to Raptor’s Ride (Black) and is another bumpy Black glade run that starts on Expressway (Green) and leads down to Sunset Boulevard (Green).

tags.name: Dave Murray Downhill - Lower
tags.description: Dave Murray Downhill - Lower is a big, long Black run from Expressway (Green) all the way down to Creekside base.

tags.name: Olympic - Lower
tags.description: Olympic - Lower is the main Green run down to Whistler Village base.   It is wide, easy and groomed.

tags.name: Bear Cub
tags.description: Bear Cub is a long, flat Green that runs from the Franz’s Chairlift base area across the side of the mountain and then zig zags down to the Big Red Express Chairlift base area.

tags.name: Tokum
tags.description: Tokum is a Blue that starts on the right side (looking downhill) of the Dave Murray Downhill (Black) and runs over to the Garbanzo Express Chairlift base area.

tags.name: Fallaway Bypass
tags.description: Lower Dave Murray Downhill is a big, long Black run from Expressway (Green) all the way down to Creekside base.

tags.name: Crabapple - Middle
tags.description: Crabapple runs down from Expressway through the Lower Frontend of Whistler and ends down on Lower Olympic near the Village.   This middle section runs from near the top of the Fitzsimmons Express Chairlift to Olympic - Lower.

tags.name: Bear Paw
tags.description: Bear Paw is steep Black that starts off the right side (looking downhill) of Upper Dave Murray Downhill (Black) and runs down to Garbanzo Express Chairlift base.

tags.name: Bear Paw
tags.description: Bear Paw is steep Black that starts off the right side (looking downhill) of Upper Dave Murray Downhill (Black) and runs down to Garbanzo Express Chairlift base.

tags.name: Fitz
tags.description: Fitz is a short Green that runs down from behind the top of the Fitzsimmons Express Chairlift to join with Lower Olympic (Green).
4.6 is an alternative exit from grand finale, often used when Slalom race training is taking place

tags.name: Seppo's - Lower
tags.description: Seppo's - Lower is an ungroomed Blue that runs from the bottom of Seppo's (where it meets Ptarmigan) down to Expressway just above the bottom of the Garbanzo Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Crabapple - Upper
tags.description: Crabapple runs down from Expressway through the Lower Frontend of Whistler and ends down on Lower Olympic near the Village.   This upper section runs from Expressway to near the top of the Fitzsimmons Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Foxy Hollow
tags.description: Foxy Hollow is a wide flat Green that runs from the top of the Olympic Chairlift down to the the Whistler Gondola Mid Station.  This run is one of the 2 main runs through the learning area.

tags.name: Yellow Brick Road
tags.description: Yellow Brick Road is a short, easy Green that runs from the top of the Magic Chair back down to Blackcomb base.

tags.name: Merlin
tags.description: Merlin is a wide, flat Green that runs from the bottom of Mainline down to the bottom of the Blackcomb Gondola.

tags.name: Lower Olympic
tags.description: Lower Olympic is the main Green run down to Whistler Village base.   It is wide, easy and groomed.

tags.name: Crabapple Connector
tags.description: This is a short Blue that connects to the bottom of Olympic - Lower to Crabapple - Lower.

tags.name: Crabapple - Lower
tags.description: Crabapple runs down from Expressway through the Lower Frontend of Whistler and ends down on Lower Olympic near the Village.   This lower section runs from Olympic - Lower and then ends down on Olympic - Lower further down the hill.

tags.name: Village Run
tags.description: Village run is a short, narrow green that runs from the Excalibur Gondola Mid Station down to Whistler base.

tags.name: Espresso
tags.description: Espresso is made up of several ungroomed, bumpy Blue sections under the Excelerator Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Honeycomb
tags.description: Honeycomb is medium wide Blue that starts on Wishbone just past where Cruiser (Blue) starts.  It runs parallel to Cruiser down the frontside and ends where the Blackcomb Glacier Road (Blue) and Greenline (Green) meet just above the bottom Excelerator.

tags.name: Cruiser - Lower
tags.description: Lower Cruiser is a wide, relatively easier Blue that starts near the top of the Excalibur Gondola / bottom of the upper section Cruiser and runs down to Blackcomb base.

tags.name: School Marm
tags.description: This is a short, narrower Blue that runs from Greenline (Green), through a forested area parallel to the Blackcomb Gondola and then ends on Greenline  at the bottom.

tags.name: Gear Jammer - Lower
tags.description: Gear Jammer - Lower is a steep Blue that starts below Easy Out (Green) and runs down into Blackcomb Lower Frontside where it ends on Greenline (Green) just above the Blackcomb Tube Park.

tags.piste:name: Blackcomb Bench Climb
tags.note: location approximate

tags.name: Lot 6 Access
tags.description: Homerun and is a ski-out trail  that leads to some of the buildings in the Blackcomb Upper Benchlands.   Homerun zig zags down through the forest beside and touches Lower Cruiser at several points.

tags.name: Shorthorn
tags.description: Shorthorn is a short Blue that runs from the bottom of Excelerator Express Chairlift, under the Excalibur Gondola and then connects with Lower Cruiser (Blue).

tags.name: Gear Jammer - Upper
tags.description: Upper Gear Jammer is the shortest of the 5 Black mogul runs on Blackcomb Upper Frontside.  It is the furthest most to the left (looking downhill) and runs from Greenline (Green) down to Easy Out (Green).

tags.name: Stoker
tags.description: Stoker is a Blue that starts on the left side (looking downhill) of Springboard (Blue), runs down parallel to Cruiser (Blue) and then ends on Greenline (Green).

tags.name: Grub Stake
tags.description: Grubstake is a short Blue that starts at the intersection of Greenline (Green) and Stoker (Blue), crosses Greenline (Green) and ends on Lower Cruiser (Blue).

tags.name: Freefall
tags.description: Freefall is a slightly longer version of Black Magic (Black), running from Greenline (Green), under the Blackcomb Gondola and down to Easy Out (Green).

tags.name: Undercut
tags.description: Undercut is a short, steep Black mogul run similar to Freefall (Black) and Black Magic (Black).  It starts on the left side (looking downhill) of Freefall (Black), crosses Easy Out (Green) and ends down to Lower Gear Jammer (Blue).

tags.name: Black Magic
tags.description: Black Magic starts on Greenline (Green), runs parallel with Sorcerer (Black) and Freefall (Black) and ends at the bottom on Easy Out (Green) just above the Blackcomb Gondola Mid Station.

tags.name: Mainline - Upper
tags.description: Upper Mainline is a short Blue with some steep sections that runs from just below the Blackcomb Gondola Mid Station down to Greenline (Green).

tags.name: Jackpot
tags.description: Jackpot is wide Blue that runs from Cruiser down to the Blackcomb Gondola Mid Station.

tags.name: Shorthorn
tags.description: Shorthorn is a short Blue that runs from the bottom of Excelerator Express Chairlift, under the Excalibur Gondola and then connects with Lower Cruiser (Blue).

tags.name: Easy Out
tags.description: Easy Out is a long winding Green that curves back and forth across the left side (looking downhill) of the upper frontside of Blackcomb and ends on Greenline (green) just above the Blackcomb Gondola Mid Station.

tags.name: Countdown
tags.description: Countdown a short, medium wide Blue with a slightly steep first section.  It starts on Easy Out (Green), crosses Last Resort (Green) and curves down to end on Big Easy (Green).

tags.name: Racer Alley
tags.description: Racer Alley is a short Blue that starts on the left side of Countdown (Blue) and ends on Big Easy (Green).

tags.name: Catskinner
tags.description: Catskinner is a wide, steep Black run that is normally groomed but often is left to become a mogul run.  It starts on the right side of Expressway (Green) and runs down to join Easy Out (Green)

tags.name: Blackcomb Terrain Park Intermediate Zone
tags.description: The Blackcomb Terrain Park starts just below the top of the Catskinner Chairlift and includes medium, large and extra large features and is designed for intermediate and expert park skiers.

tags.name: Blackcomb Terrain Park Expert Zone
tags.description: The Blackcomb Terrain Park starts just below the top of the Catskinner Chairlift and includes medium, large and extra large features and is designed for intermediate and expert park skiers.

tags.name: Springboard
tags.description: Springboard is a big, wide blue with steep sections.  It starts just below the top of the Blackcomb Gondola, runs down to and crosses Greenline (Green) and then continues down between Cruiser (Blue) and Stoker (Blue) to end on Greenline.

tags.name: Ross's Gold
tags.description: Ross’s Gold is a wide Blue with steep sections that starts below Rendezvous Lodge on the left side of Wishbone (Blue) and runs down to Greenline (Green).  NOTE: This run is regularly used for ski race training and so is often closed to the public.

tags.name: Bark Sandwich
tags.description: Bark Sandwich is a longer, difficult Black glade run that starts on Expressway (Green), runs parallel to Catskinner run (Black) downhill and ends on Easy Out (Green).

tags.name: Luger's Run
tags.description: Luger's Run is an unmarked Black that runs underneath the Peak 2 Peak Gondola between Expressway (Green) at the top and Sunset Boulevard at the bottom.   This is a challenge bumpy, off-piste run with glade sections.

tags.name: Blackcomb Merlin's Magic Castle
tags.description: The Magic Castle is a fun tree fort for kids in the trees below the lower part of the Catskinner Chairlift.  It is accessible from the top on the left side of Last Resort (Green) just below where the Catskinner Chairlift passes overhead.

tags.name: Sunnyside Up
tags.description: Sunnyside Up is a short Green that runs from the bottom of the Catskinner Express Chairlift over to end on Sunset Boulevard.

tags.name: Little Cub
tags.description: Little Cub is a short Black glade run with an easier slope and well spaced trees.  It starts on Easy Out (Green) and ends on Big Easy (Green).

tags.name: Renegade
tags.description: Renegade is a short Black glade run (similar to Little Cub) in the “tree island” between Easy Out (Green), Big Easy (Green) and Countdown (Blue).  It starts on Last Resort (Green) and ends on Countdown (Blue).

tags.name: 7th Heaven Avenue Glades
tags.description: The 7th Heaven Avenue Glades is an area of unmarked, tight, Black glades that run from 7th Heaven Avenue (Green) down to Expressway (Green) or to Easy Out (Green).

tags.name: Southside Green
tags.description: Southside Green is the Green that runs from the top of the 7th Heaven Express Chairlift, zig zags down the front of this area and then exits to the right towards the top of the Jersey Cream Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Wishbone
tags.description: Wishbone is a medium wide Blue that runs from below Rendezvous Lodge down towards the bottom of Jersey Cream Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Jersey Cream
tags.description: Jersey Cream Run is one of the 2 main Blues that run down from the top of Jersey Cream Express Chairlift down to the bottom of the chairlift.

tags.name: Glacier Drive
tags.description: Glacier Drive is Black that starts behind Horstman Hut, runs down the middle of the Glacier Express Chairlift area and ends down at the bottom of the chairlift next to the Glacier Creek Lodge.   The top part of this run used to be called Blue Line.

tags.name: Saudan Couloir
tags.description: The Saudan Couloir run is the world famous, steep Double Black that runs down the center of the Saudan Couloir and ends down in the Jersey Cream Bowl.

tags.name: Jersey Cream
tags.description: Jersey Cream Run is one of the 2 main Blues that run down from the top of Jersey Cream Express Chairlift down to the bottom of the chairlift.

tags.name: Blowdown
tags.description: Blowdown is a bumpy Black run from Coyote Road down to Wishbone (Blue).   You can access it by turning right off of Jersey Cream Run (Blue) on to Coyote Road and then turning left onto Blowdown.

tags.name: Cougar Chutes
tags.piste:name: Cougar Chute
tags.description: Cougar Chutes is a steep Black run that starts at the very end of Secret Bowl and runs down into the Jersey Cream Express Chairlift area below.

tags.name: Quasar
tags.piste:name: Quasar
tags.description: Quasar is the the easier (but still challenging), steep Black route down into the Saudan Couloir.  It starts to the right of the Saudan Couloir (Double Black), curves to the right side of the moraine and ends in the top of the Jersey Cream Bowl.

tags.name: Chainsaw Ridge
tags.description: Chainsaw Ridge is an unmarked, off-piste Black route that runs down beside the cliff edge on the right (looking uphill) of the Saudan Couloir.

tags.name: Lower Feather Tree
tags.description: Lower Feather Tree is the steep, wide slope on the right side of the lower side of the Saudan Couloir and above the Jersey Cream Bowl.   You can access Upper Feather Tree (Double Black) via a traverse on the right 1/3rd the way down Quasar (Double Black).

tags.name: Regulator
tags.description: Upper Jersey Cream Bowl Wall - This the wall below the lower end of Chainsaw Ridge, near the top of Jersey Cream Express Chairlift.   There are several different Black and Double Black routes down this wall along its face.

tags.name: Dogleg
tags.description: Upper Jersey Cream Bowl Wall - This the wall below the lower end of Chainsaw Ridge, near the top of Jersey Cream Express Chairlift.   There are several different Black and Double Black routes down this wall along its face.

tags.name: Purple Haze
tags.description: This a steep, narrow, rocky, difficult Triple Black that starts over a cornice, becomes a bench and then runs down on to the mogul field below Cougar Chutes and above Coyote Road.

tags.name: Everglades
tags.description: The Everglades is a wide area of Black glade skiing that runs from Greenline (Green) above down to 7th Avenue (Green) below.

tags.name: 7th Heaven Avenue Glades
tags.description: The 7th Heaven Avenue Glades is an area of unmarked, tight, Black glades that run from 7th Heaven Avenue (Green) down to Expressway (Green) or to Easy Out (Green).

tags.name: Coyote Road
tags.description: Coyote Road is a flat, unmarked Blue that runs from the side of Jersey Cream Run (Blue) over to Blue Line (Blue).

tags.name: Hooker Hump
tags.description: Hooker Hump is an unmarked “run” the follows along below the Jersey Cream Express Chairlift as it goes over a hump below and beside Jersey Cream Run (Blue).

tags.name: Hooker Hump
tags.description: Hooker Hump is an unmarked “run” the follows along below the Jersey Cream Express Chairlift as it goes over a hump below and beside Jersey Cream Run (Blue).

tags.name: K Bumps
tags.description: K Bumps is a short set of Black moguls on the far left side of the Jersey Cream cliffs.  You can access this run from the right side of Wishbone (Blue).

tags.name: Tree Fall
tags.description: Tree Fall Chute is a small Black chute squeezed between the trees on the far left (looking downhill) of the Jersey Cream cliffs.   You can access this chute from the right side of Wishbone (Blue).

tags.name: Pumphouse Roll
tags.description: Pumphouse Roll is the small Black roll just to the right (looking downhill) of Jersey Cream cliffs.   You can access this roll from the right side of Wishbone (Blue).

tags.name: Wishbone Connector
tags.description: Wishbone Connector is a short Blue connector run from the top of the Catskinner Chairlift and Blackcomb Gondola over to Wishbone.

tags.name: Expressway
tags.description: Expressway is a long, narrow, relatively flat Green that runs from near the top of the Catskinner Chairlift / Rendezvous Lodge area, around the mountain and down to the bottom of the 7th Heaven Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Expressway Access
tags.description: This is a short access path from the Peak 2 Peak Gondola over to Catskinner area and Expressway.
Cafe Chute is the small, steep Black chute in the middle of the Jersey Cream cliffs.

tags.name: Cafe Chute
tags.description: Cafe Chute is the small, steep Black chute in the middle of the Jersey Cream cliffs.

tags.name: Hot Tub
tags.description: Upper Jersey Cream Bowl Wall - This the wall below the lower end of Chainsaw Ridge, near the top of Jersey Cream Express Chairlift.   There are several different Black and Double Black routes down this wall along its face.

tags.name: Low Test
tags.description: Upper Jersey Cream Bowl Wall - This the wall below the lower end of Chainsaw Ridge, near the top of Jersey Cream Express Chairlift.   There are several different Black and Double Black routes down this wall along its face.

tags.name: High Test
tags.description: Upper Jersey Cream Bowl Wall - This the wall below the lower end of Chainsaw Ridge, near the top of Jersey Cream Express Chairlift.   There are several different Black and Double Black routes down this wall along its face.

tags.name: Jersey Cream wall
tags.description: Jersey Cream Wall is a bumpy Black face below the top of Jersey Cream Express Chairlift.  It has less steep on the right (looking downhill) and more steep on the left (looking downhill) sections.

tags.name: Jersey Cream Wall
